metadata.description: Modular, harness-agnostic plugins for AI coding agents covering execution safety, code taste, web stylesheet conventions, and DIY learning.

extensions.name: new-worker
extensions.description: Harness-agnostic agent execution bundle covering operational safety gates, Mode 1 chat flow, host-native artifact workflows, bulk questioning (new::ask), Practical Software STE documentation (new::docs), IntelliJ IDE MCP escalation (new::tools-intellij), and repository scouting (new::project-scout).

extensions.name: new-personal
extensions.description: Personal engineering taste and code style preferences for human-readable, removable code, caller-focused error design, readable functional pipelines, documented dense code, and codebase untangling.

extensions.name: new-framework-web
extensions.description: Web frontend framework and stylesheet guidelines, including RSCSS conventions for scalable CSS and SCSS architecture.

extensions.name: new-learning
extensions.description: Self-learning DIY coaching plugin with calibrated study blueprints (guide mode) and chunked Socratic pair coding with tiered hints and explain-back reviews (active mode).
